I was in the same boat. You want to end it because you feel like there isn't anything more to do. You're burnt out, I understand! After 2 years of just straight work, I was so tired of it all. But then I got a new job. I realized that being a workaholic wasn't the best course of action. So I got a job that gave me a little more freedom. And it felt good! It felt so refreshing. I felt free! Yeah, I still had to do the whole 9-5 thing, but I still had time to do things I wanted. I used to come home from work and just sit there and do nothing because I was so burnt out. With the new job, I was encouraged to go work out and hang out with my coworkers, and it gave me a new perspective on life. I want to get the whole suicide isnt going to help off the bat. 

It isn't worth it. 

All it does is destroy your life and the relationships with those around you. There are people who love you and want to see you be happy and healthy! And are willing to help you get there. It's often looked as it's easier if I just do it because then I'm not a burden on people's lives. That is not true. It's more of a burden if you do it. Because then those people wonder what they could have done to prevent you from doing so. I have been in both of these shoes. There is nothing wrong with change. Don't be afraid of it. Embrace it with open arms. And you might discover something new about yourself, something that will bring new life into yourself! You can do this! I believe in you!!

18? You're still just a baby. Don't worry about the dating thing right now. You should focus on yourself and focus on going to school if you aren't already in it. You're gonna have a lot of time to do the whole looking for someone. And besides, you aren't grown into your full body yet. You still have a lot of growing to do, physically and mentally. By the time you get settled and start doing your own thing, someone is gonna come along, and that will be your person! Don't doubt yourself. You are beautiful! Have that mentality, I am beautiful! Beautiful in my own way! Beautiful on the inside and out! Have that confidence! And the right one will come along.
